steps.summary: Logged into Grafana as admin, skipped the password change prompt, navigated to the "Service Health" dashboard via the search menu, and identified all 3 panels on the dashboard. In order from top to bottom: "Request rate", "Error count", and "Latency by endpoint".

Created a new dashboard in Grafana with a Stat panel using the TestData data source (default Random Walk scenario), titled the panel "rpgr8-r1 Availability", and saved the dashboard as "rpgr8-r1 Bench Dashboard" (General folder). Verified on screen after saving: dashboard title "rpgr8-r1 Bench Dashboard" and panel title "rpgr8-r1 Availability" (showing A-series value 106).

Opened the "rpgr8-r1 Bench Dashboard" and added a new Text panel. Set the panel title to "rpgr8-r1 Notes" and entered markdown content reading "Notes for run rpgr8-r1 - bench dashboard created via automation." Saved the dashboard (no default time range change). After saving, the dashboard shows both panels: "rpgr8-r1 Availability" (Stat, value 43.3) and "rpgr8-r1 Notes" (Text, displaying the notes content).
